purpose: Record one complete team that Pokémon Champions accepts under Regulation M-B.
construction_rule: Populate after C003/C004 eligibility proof. Use only species/forms shown as eligible in-game. Keep a screenshot/video trail from team builder to validation.
red_lines: Do not assert this team is legal until C008 shows accepted status.
Do not infer forms from species names.
Do not use community sites as final proof of team legality.

purpose: Record one complete team that Pokémon Champions rejects under Regulation M-B, preferably by mutating exactly one field from TEAM-ACCEPT-001.
construction_rule: Clone TEAM-ACCEPT-001 after it is accepted. Change exactly one rule-sensitive element. Capture the validation rejection and exact reason text.

preferred_mutations.use_only_if: C001 rules screen or C009 rejection reason confirms duplicate held items are not allowed under Regulation M-B.

preferred_mutations.mutation: Swap one slot to an ineligible species/form
preferred_mutations.use_only_if: C003/C004 eligible list proves the swapped species/form is not eligible or the validation message says it is not eligible.

preferred_mutations.mutation: Remove/change required Mega Stone from a Mega-intended slot
preferred_mutations.use_only_if: C005/C007 proves the team is relying on a Mega requirement and C009 gives a rejection reason.

team_slots: Clone TEAM-ACCEPT-001, then apply one preferred_mutation only.
red_lines: Do not create multiple simultaneous invalid changes.
Do not write a rejection reason unless the game displays it.
Do not call the mutation illegal unless supported by C001 or C009.
